description: Parse Vault audit log JSON from log field into structured fields

script.description: Merge parsed fields into document root and flatten problematic nested objects
script.source: if (ctx._parsed == null) return; for (def entry : ctx._parsed.entrySet()) { if (entry.getKey() != 'time' ) { ctx[entry.getKey()] = entry.getValue(); } } if (ctx.request != null && ctx.request.namespace instanceof Map) { ctx.request.namespace_id = ctx.request.namespace.get('id' ); ctx.request.remove('namespace' ); } if (ctx.auth != null && ctx.auth.policy_results instanceof Map) { ctx.auth.remove('policy_results' ); } if (ctx.request != null && ctx.request.mount_running_version != null) { ctx.request.remove('mount_running_version' ); } if (ctx.request != null && ctx.request.mount_class != null) { ctx.request.remove('mount_class' ); } if (ctx.request != null && ctx.request.mount_point != null) { ctx.request.remove('mount_point' ); }
